high_level_description: This image depicts a display of four ancient stone columns arranged on a white pedestal against a plain wall in what appears to be an indoor museum or gallery setting. The columns are made of light-colored stone and feature intricate carvings at their capitals (the topmost part of the column). Each capital has unique designs, including figures and possibly symbolic motifs. The setting is minimalistic, with a clean, white wall and a simple floor that contrasts with the darker ceiling above. The ceiling has recessed lighting fixtures, which provide illumination for the exhibit.
